metas.name: Mean Girls
metas.description: Like Clueless and 10 Things I Hate About You, this is a peak teen comedy classic filled with iconic lines and sharp wit.

metas.name: Easy A
metas.description: A clever high school rom-com inspired by classic literature, matching the sharp-tongued charm of 10 Things I Hate About You.

metas.name: Legally Blonde
metas.description: Captures the pink, optimistic, and highly fashionable feminine power of Clueless.

metas.name: She's the Man
metas.description: Another hilarious Shakespeare-adapted teen rom-com with the exact same energetic flavor as 10 Things I Hate About You.

metas.name: Romy and Michele's High School Reunion
metas.description: A delightful 90s buddy comedy that matches the fashion-forward and lovable vibe of Clueless.

metas.name: The Mummy
metas.description: The gold standard for action-adventure-comedy, aligning perfectly with the fun-spirited thrills of Jumanji and Dungeons & Dragons.

metas.name: Guardians of the Galaxy
metas.description: Brings the exact same cosmic, music-heavy, and banter-filled superhero energy as Thor: Ragnarok.

metas.name: Knives Out
metas.description: Since you are looking forward to Wake Up Dead Man, dive into the brilliant, star-studded mystery that started the franchise.

metas.name: Glass Onion: A Knives Out Mystery
metas.description: A hilarious, puzzle-box sequel to Knives Out that fans of clever crime-comedies like Get Shorty will adore.

metas.name: Kiss Kiss Bang Bang
metas.description: Directed by Shane Black, this film delivers the same snappy, hilarious detective buddy-chemistry as The Nice Guys.

metas.name: Game Night
metas.description: A whip-smart and incredibly funny mystery comedy that matches the high-energy chaos of The Nice Guys.

metas.name: Free Guy
metas.description: A video-game-centered adventure comedy packed with visual effects, matching the fun of the Jumanji films.

metas.name: Stardust
metas.description: A whimsical, romantic fantasy adventure that echoes the lighthearted world-building of Fantastic Beasts.

metas.name: The Princess Bride
metas.description: A timeless, cozy fantasy comedy that perfectly blends romance, adventure, and sharp humor.

metas.name: Love and Monsters
metas.description: A highly entertaining, post-apocalyptic adventure with great creature designs and a heart of gold.

metas.name: Bullet Train
metas.description: A fast-paced, star-studded action comedy with witty banter that fits right in with Thor: Ragnarok and The Nice Guys.

metas.name: The Lost City
metas.description: A lighthearted jungle-trekking romantic adventure comedy that channels the spirit of Jumanji.

metas.name: Borat
metas.description: From the same creative mind behind Brüno, this mockumentary is famously hilarious, chaotic, and bold.

metas.name: The Mask
metas.description: A high-energy Jim Carrey comedy that pairs perfectly with Ace Ventura: Pet Detective.

metas.name: Dumb and Dumber
metas.description: A quintessential 90s slapstick comedy for fans of Ace Ventura who love absurd, laugh-out-loud humor.

metas.name: Liar Liar
metas.description: Another stellar Jim Carrey comedy that balances hilarious physical humor with a heartfelt, lighthearted story.

metas.name: Tropic Thunder
metas.description: A hysterical, star-studded action comedy that isn't afraid to go all-out with its satire, appealing to fans of Brüno.

metas.name: Logan Lucky
metas.description: A slick, Southern-fried heist comedy with a great ensemble cast, matching the breezy crime fun of Get Shorty.

metas.name: Ocean's Eleven
metas.description: The ultimate cool, witty, and smooth heist film that fans of Get Shorty and The Nice Guys will love relaxing to.

metas.name: Hot Fuzz
metas.description: A brilliant, fast-paced action-comedy that subverts buddy-cop tropes with immense charm, perfect for fans of The Nice Guys.

metas.name: The Heat
metas.description: Sandra Bullock and Melissa McCarthy have incredible buddy-cop chemistry in this riotous, laugh-a-minute comedy.

metas.name: Scott Pilgrim vs. the World
metas.description: Highly stylized, funny, and energetic, matching the unique visual flair of Night Is Short, Walk On Girl.

metas.name: The Mitchells vs. the Machines
metas.description: A gorgeously animated, hilarious, and heartwarming sci-fi comedy that is pure comfort food.

metas.name: The Grand Budapest Hotel
metas.description: A whimsical, beautifully symmetrical caper comedy filled with eccentric characters and lighthearted charm.

metas.name: Lu Over the Wall
metas.description: Directed by Masaaki Yuasa (who directed Night Is Short, Walk On Girl), this is a delightfully trippy, visual, and heartwarming fantasy.

metas.name: Tremors
metas.description: A campy, thrilling, and highly comedic creature feature that pairs beautifully with Anaconda.

metas.name: Cocaine Bear
metas.description: A wildly fun, chaotic, and self-aware creature feature that doesn't take itself seriously, much like Anaconda.

metas.name: Enchanted
metas.description: A charming, self-aware musical fantasy rom-com that shares the magical, feel-good vibes of Practical Magic.

metas.name: Death Becomes Her
metas.description: A wickedly funny, campy fantasy-comedy about vanity and magic, matching the gothic-lite fun of Practical Magic.

metas.name: A Simple Favor
metas.description: A stylish, twisty, and darkly comedic mystery thriller that will appeal to fans of Get Shorty and Knives Out.

metas.name: Shazam!
metas.description: A superhero film that feels more like a fun 80s adventure comedy, keeping things light, heroic, and highly entertaining.

metas.name: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
metas.description: Offers breathtaking visuals, incredibly sharp humor, and high-octane comic book fun.

metas.name: Zombieland
metas.description: A hilarious, fast-paced horror-comedy that makes a zombie apocalypse feel like a fun road trip.

metas.name: Spy
metas.description: Melissa McCarthy shines in this highly entertaining, action-packed, and genuinely hilarious espionage comedy.

metas.name: Amélie
metas.description: A whimsical, romantic, and visually stunning French comedy that feels like a warm hug, matching the magical vibe of Night Is Short, Walk On Girl.
